_comment: Everything the drama coach and the witch say. Edit freely - the flow lives in HexeDirector, the words live here. Each entry in 'lines' is a list of variants; one is picked at random. A variant may hold several short sentences; each is spoken as its own utterance. Inline tags at the start of a sentence: [g:Gesture] plays a body gesture, [f:Face] sets a facial expression. Placeholders: {coach}, {role}, {focusEmotion}, {focusReason}, {lineEmotion}, {lineReason}.
focusReason: Remember, the witch wants to eat him!

scene.speaker: witch
scene.text: Good morning, my little roast! Stick out your finger. I want to feel if you are fat yet.

scene.speaker: student
scene.text: Gretel, quick! Give me the bone. She can't see very well.
scene.reason: The witch must not hear his plan!
scene.modelText: Gretel... quick! Give me the bone. She can't see very well.

scene.speaker: witch
scene.text: What are you whispering, boy? Your finger. Now!

scene.speaker: student
scene.text: Here... here it is. My finger. Please don't squeeze too hard!
scene.reason: If she finds out it's a bone, he is lost!
scene.modelText: Here... here it is. My finger. Please, please don't squeeze too hard!

scene.speaker: witch
scene.text: Hmm. Still so thin! Like a dry old stick. Four weeks, and still nothing!

scene.speaker: student
scene.text: I'm sorry! I eat and eat, but I stay so skinny. Maybe I'm just a bony boy.
scene.reason: He pretends to be sad, so the witch feels sorry for him.
scene.modelText: I'm sorry... I eat and eat, but I stay so skinny. Maybe I'm just... a bony boy.

scene.speaker: witch
scene.text: Fat or thin, I don't care. Tomorrow I light the oven!

scene.speaker: student
scene.text: The oven?! You can't do that! We never did anything to you!
scene.reason: She wants to cook him, and he did nothing wrong!
scene.modelText: The oven?! You can't do that! We never did anything to you!

scene.speaker: witch
scene.text: Oh, don't be angry, my dear. Gretel can help me heat it up.

scene.speaker: student
scene.text: I'm not scared of you. My sister and I are much cleverer than you think.
scene.reason: He is locked in a cage, but he wants to be strong.
scene.modelText: I'm not scared of you. My sister and I... are much cleverer than you think.

scene.speaker: witch
scene.text: Cleverer? Hee hee. We will see tomorrow, little roast.

coachPersona: You are {coach}, a warm and playful drama coach. You live inside an interactive avatar at an exhibition about reading. Visitors are often children aged 11 to 13 who are learning English. Today you play the witch from Hansel and Gretel, and the visitor reads Hansel's part. In today's scene, the witch has locked Hansel in a cage to make him fat, and he tricks her with a bone instead of his finger. Your goal is to help them read fluently and with feeling. Speak simple English. Use very short sentences. Never lecture.
